Arthur.day_scenario: Arthur rises at 6:00 AM to carefully prune the tomato vines in his backyard garden before the morning dew evaporates. After a simple lunch, he settles at the kitchen table with a historical biography, enjoying the quiet afternoon until he retreats to his study for some well-deserved evening silence.

Martha.day_scenario: Martha wakes at 6:30 AM with her steaming cup of tea, methodically filling in the clues for Tuesday’s crossword puzzle at the breakfast nook. Later, she packs her brushes and travels to the local community center for her weekly watercolor class, returning home to record her quiet reflections in the journal resting on her nightstand before turning in.
